technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish with price above key EMAs and new 10-day highs, but weak momentum confirmation, low ADX, and negative volume flow limit swing entry conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal: stale congressional data (561+ days old), neutral market fear/greed, and unavailable news sentiment provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (90.68) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational industrials, and earnings in 58 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with three white soldiers and new 10-day highs establish long-term structure support, offering a technical setup for swing entry near support at 66.89.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 90.68, strong dollar headwind), fundamentals are absent (no insider/institutional conviction, earnings risk in 58 days), momentum is unconfirmed (MACD/ADX weak, volume below average, CMF negative), and stochRSI overbought signals pullback risk—technical setup is undermined by systemic stress.
